column1: # p188 — ACTION MW. P1054 (compose/code/p1054-mit-plus-clause/mit_plus.py, UNMODIFIED) run
# over every row this KB publishes as MIT in its p185-p188 sections. 46 rows + 1 negative.
# LIMB 1 (>=1 further MIT-body-plus-a-clause -> graspful is a pattern and a published
#         licence is wrong somewhere) : FIRES, TWICE, and the mechanism is NEW.
# LIMB 2 (0 -> the MIT column is clean): does not fire.
#   POSITIVE willwearing/graspful -> NOT-OPEN-SOURCE:added-restriction, 1 439 B, 289 B excess,
#            hits compete/hosted, managed/saas/software-as-a-service. REPRODUCES p187 EXACTLY.
#   The sweep did NOT return a uniform verdict: 30 MIT, 13 NOT-MIT-BODY, 1 restricted,
#   1 MIT-BODY-PLUS, 1 not-read. Per p187's rule, it measured something.
# THE ROW THAT FIRED, AND WHAT THE 178 B ACTUALLY IS:
# ktwyw/python-for-engineers, LICENSE, 1 328 B. Read verbatim over the raw channel at HEAD
# 609d8459, the addition is NOT a narrowing — the MIT operative text is verbatim and intact:
#   "Code in this repository (src/, tests/, *.py) is licensed under the MIT License.
#    Teaching materials (notebooks, README files, cheatsheets, datasets created
#    for this course) are licensed under CC BY 4.0."
# This is a SCOPE SPLIT. New instrument P1056, 16/16 tests passing:
# THE SECOND INSTANCE, found by probing for the shape and declared in a DIFFERENT PLACE:
# `data/`, `schema/` and the term lists in `sources/`): [CC BY 4.0](LICENSE-DATA)."
# Measured: LICENSE 1 077 B (MIT) + LICENSE-DATA 17 023 B (full CC BY 4.0 text, HTTP 200).
# 🔴 This KB published spedlex as MIT. The SPED VOCABULARY — the asset p187 called "the
# unglamorous asset nobody budgets for and every SPED engagement needs" — is CC BY 4.0.
# IN BOTH INSTANCES THE CC HALF IS THE HALF A STUDIO WANTS, and CC BY's attribution
# requirement is irrevocable. Neither can be silently white-labelled into a client course.
# A PUBLISHED FIGURE THAT NEEDS WIDENING: p187 published canonical MIT at 1 062-1 093 B over
# 15 rows. Over 30 genuine MIT rows this pass the range is 1 063-1 114 B — lplnufpi/essay-br
# measures 1 114 B, ABOVE p187's ceiling. No row was misclassified, because P1054's constant
# MIT_CANONICAL_HIGH = 1 150 was set with headroom. The PUBLISHED RANGE was too narrow; the
# instrument was not. Both facts are recorded because only one of them was a risk.
# INSTRUMENT LIMIT, newly measured: P1054's restriction vocabulary only runs AFTER its
# MIT-body marker matches. No-Suggest/NoSuggest (417 B: "personal non-commercial use only",
# "may NOT redistribute", "competing product", "All rights reserved") has no MIT body, so
# P1054 returns NOT-MIT-BODY and says nothing about a licence that is plainly restricted.
# 🔴 A NOT-MIT-BODY verdict is NOT a clean bill. 13 rows above carry it.
